hed: Pennsylvania man charged with receiving rifle and ammo for alleged ISIS attack plot
dek: Federal prosecutors in the Western District of Pennsylvania charged Jonathan Hunter Kramer, 21, of Valencia in Butler County, on Tuesday with receiving a firearm and ammunition knowing or having reasonable cause to believe they would be used to commit a felony or federal crime of terrorism, including material support to a designated foreign terrorist organization. According to the Justice Department, FBI agents approached Kramer this weekend as he returned to a Cranberry Township hotel with rifle magazines and ammunition, then seized a semiautomatic rifle, five magazines, about 190 rounds, knives, and other items under search warrants. The DOJ Office of Public Affairs release included statements from Attorney General Todd Blanche and FBI Director Kash Patel; Kramer made an initial appearance Sept. 14, and prosecutors sought detention.

byline: Event summary from public reporting and named outlets

cl.body: NBC News (Shayna Jacobs), the DOJ Office of Public Affairs release, and ABC News emphasize a complaint alleging an ISIS-linked firearm plot interrupted at a Cranberry Township hotel — detailing Kramer’s prior 2023 juvenile adjudication, the March 2026 tip after his release, Telegram persona claims including “Hamza Al Rashid,” and Patel/Blanche statements timed near the 25th anniversary of 9/11 — while stressing the filing is an accusation and that no specific attack target was identified in the public materials.

cr.body: Fox News (Stephen Sorace), the same DOJ OPA release, and The Washington Times frame Tuesday’s charge as an FBI interdiction that seized a semiautomatic rifle, magazines, and about 190 rounds after tracking Kramer to the hotel — foregrounding Patel’s line that the subject was allegedly plotting a violent ISIS-support attack while acquiring weapons, the prior juvenile mass-casualty plot history, and Blanche’s statement that partners thwarted the alleged attack before innocent lives could be lost.

stack_blurb: PA man charged with receiving rifle/ammo for alleged ISIS terrorism plot; FBI seized ~190 rounds.
seo_description: Jonathan Hunter Kramer, 21, of Valencia, Pa., was federally charged with receiving a firearm and ammunition for an alleged ISIS-linked terrorism plot after FBI seizure of a rifle and about 190 rounds.
